query:
SELECT DISTINCT e.question_id
        FROM evaluations e
        JOIN sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id
        WHERE e.owner_id = $1
          AND s.owner_id = $1
          AND s.company_id = ANY($2)
          AND s.role = $3
          AND s.status = 'ended'
          AND s.id IN (
              SELECT id FROM sessions
              WHERE owner_id = $1
                AND company_id = ANY($2)
                AND role = $3
                AND status = 'ended'
              ORDER BY started_at DESC
              LIMIT $4
          )
